description: This file is a test script for Git's multi-pack index functionality, including setup, verification, corruption simulation, and maintenance operations such as writing, verifying, and expiring multi-pack indices and related pack files.

methods.name: midx_read_expect
methods.description: Reads and validates the contents of a multi-pack index against expected values.

methods.name: generate_objects
methods.description: Generates random objects and updates the git index for testing pack creation.

methods.name: commit_and_list_objects
methods.description: Creates a commit and lists the objects, used for creating test data.

methods.name: corrupt_midx_and_verify
methods.description: Corrupts specific parts of the midx file and verifies error handling.

methods.name: corrupt_chunk_file
methods.description: Inserts corruption into a specific chunk of the midx file.

methods.name: corrupt_data
methods.description: Utility to corrupt arbitrary data in a file at a given position.
